integrity: The formula is proved algebraically from the published modal factorization and endpoint monotonicity. A bundled numerical root checker independently replays the optimizer. MSC2020 code 65K05 was verified against the AMS MSC2020 database as numerical mathematical programming methods.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to uniform scalar curvatures, a symmetric doubly stochastic fixed consensus matrix, and a common constant stepsize.
It does not cover heterogeneous curvatures, directed or time-varying networks, vector-valued noncommuting Hessians, or uncoordinated steps.
The full texts of arXiv:2607.23601 and arXiv:2607.25463 were not retrievable during this check; abstracts and an accessible technical review were inspected, leaving a residual literature risk.
title: Exact sign-aware graph-specific tuning for homogeneous distributed gradient tracking
